messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: cache-proxy-prod high error rate (5xx) detected. Service: cache-proxy-prod, region: us-west-2. Trigger: 5xx-rate > 10% for 3m. Pager: oncall+prod.

Alex Chen: seeing spike in both 5xx and p95 latency. Some requests falling back to origin which is causing DB load. Notified infra a bit ago.

Priya Kapoor: quick handoff — I'm heading off shift, leaving this as ongoing. TL;DR: cache nodes in pool A started returning 502/504 intermittently around 11:12 PDT. Autoscaler did not immediately add capacity because eviction churn increased. We enabled read-through fallback for non-critical routes and switched heavy customers to a degraded quota.

Priya Kapoor: Impact: hosted text generation latency up ~3x for short requests (100-400ms -> 300-1200ms), occasional 5xx for streaming endpoints. Affected customers: AcmeCorp (embeddings batch jobs slowed), BrightPay (failed 2/20 requests last hour). No data loss reported.

Priya Kapoor: Who's primary/secondary for the next 4h: @Jamie Liu primary, @Matthew R secondary. Coverage gap: no infra oncall in APAC for next 2h (we tried to roster, still gap). If situation escalates and infra needs paging, reach out to oncall-infra slack channel and @infra-lead.

Priya Kapoor: Mitigations attempted:
- scaled cache-proxy-prod pool +3 nodes (manual) at 11:20 PDT
- temporarily enabled read-through fallback for embeddings path (route: /v1/embeddings) to reduce cache-miss penalty at 11:24 PDT
- increased circuit-breaker timeout for origin requests to avoid cascading failures at 11:30 PDT
- rotated one suspected bad node out of pool A at 11:38 PDT

Alex Chen: current alert queue snapshot:
- cache-proxy-prod.5xx-rate (firing)
- cache-proxy-prod.latency.p95 (warning)
- origin-db.connection-errors (flapping, seen 11:25-11:35)
- autoscaler.scale-failure (info)

Priya Kapoor: runbook pointers: see runbook "cache-proxy degraded" -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cache-proxy-degraded (steps 1-5). Quick commands:
```
# add nodes to pool (k8s):
kubectl scale deployment cache-proxy-prod --replicas=$(($(kubectl get deploy cache-proxy-prod -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}')+3)) -n production
# rotate node: annotate then drain
kubectl annotate pod cache-proxy-abc rotate=true -n production
kubectl drain cache-proxy-abc --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -n production
```

Priya Kapoor: Observability links:
- Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/cache-proxy
- Traces: https://zipkin.redwood/prod/trace?q=cache-proxy-prod

Priya Kapoor: Communications: Customer Ops notified AcmeCorp + BrightPay at 11:40 PDT with mitigation plan. If we see >10% failed requests for a customer, escalate to SE for that account.

Jamie Liu: taking primary now. Thanks Priya — I'm reading the runbook and verifying current node count. First actions: confirm scaled nodes are Ready, re-run health-checks, and check origin DB connection pool. If DB errors continue, we'll throttle embedding jobs.

Matthew R: I'll be secondary and standing by to patch configs / run the drain steps if Jamie requests. Note I can only escalate to infra lead after 12:30 PDT due to meetings; until then use oncall-infra channel.

Jamie Liu: quick status update 11:58 PDT — scaled nodes show 3 new pods but two are CrashLoopBackOff. Logs show OOM on startup for cache-proxy with shard loader. Pasting snippet:
```
E 11:57:42 cache-proxy main: shard loader OOM killed allocating 1.2G
W 11:57:43 k8s: pod cache-proxy-new failed readiness probe
```

Jamie Liu: mitigation plan now: 1) restart failed pods with reduced shard prefetch (config flag cache.shard_prefetch=0.2) 2) if restart fails, spin up smaller instance type for new pods to avoid OOM 3) if still failing, route traffic to fallback cluster in eu-west-1 for low-risk routes.

Priya Kapoor: added config change to canary at 12:05 PDT: `cache.shard_prefetch=0.2` on two new pods. Monitor p95 and OOM logs for 20m.

incident-bot: NOTE: paging threshold for origin-db.connection-errors lowered to 1% for 15m due to cascading concern.

Jamie Liu: 12:22 PDT check-in — two canary pods are Ready, memory usage stable, p95 improving from 950ms -> 420ms. 5xx-rate trending down but still at ~4.5%. Customer Ops: please update AcmeCorp that we expect improvement in 30m and offer a retry window for their batch job.

Customer Ops: Updated both customers at 12:25 PDT. AcmeCorp asked for status webhook — pinged SE to provide s3 logs. BrightPay acknowledged degraded performance and accepted workaround.

Jamie Liu: Open items for next shift / follow-up:
- watch for autoscaler failing to scale when eviction churn spikes; open a ticket to investigate heuristics (assign to eng-infra)
- confirm no data inconsistency from read-through fallback (run validation job against recent embedding writes)
- if any single customer hits >5% failures, escalate to SE and consider dedicated routing.

Jamie Liu: I'm primary until 16:30 PDT. Matthew is secondary. If you need infra escalation before 12:30 PDT, mention in oncall-infra channel and I'll try to reach infra lead.

Matthew R: ack. I'll monitor logs and be ready to patch deployment config. Leaving a note in the incident channel with the commands I used.

Priya Kapoor: thanks team — logging out. Good luck, please update thread with any customer-impacting changes. :pray:
